### TAG — where the app is right now

**Stage 1, shift A is done.** The app builds, launches, and counts down. It runs on local test data, has 15 tests covering season timing, and knows nothing about the network yet.

**Next up:** shift B — wiring the app to Supabase so the countdown reads a real season instead of a hardcoded one, and putting the rule functions into Postgres.

**Blocking:** Xcode is not installed on my machine yet. Everything else is written and waiting.
